The top-rated B2B SEO agencies in the UK include [POLARIS](https://www.polarisagency.com/marketing-insights/b2b-seo-finding-the-right-seo-agency/) for established pipeline growth, Gripped for B2B SaaS lead generation, and [The SEO Works](https://www.seoworks.co.uk/) for mid-market and technical manufacturing campaigns.[](https://www.polarisagency.com/marketing-insights/b2b-seo-finding-the-right-seo-agency/) [[1]](https://www.polarisagency.com/marketing-insights/b2b-seo-finding-the-right-seo-agency/)[[2]](https://seo-giant.co.uk/the-best-b2b-seo-agencies-in-the-uk-2026-guide/)

### Top UK B2B SEO Agencies

- **POLARIS** : Best for established B2B brands and enterprise-scale lead generation, combining organic search with content marketing and digital PR.[](https://seo-giant.co.uk/the-best-b2b-seo-agencies-in-the-uk-2026-guide/) [[1]](https://seo-giant.co.uk/the-best-b2b-seo-agencies-in-the-uk-2026-guide/)
- **Gripped** : Best for tech, IT, and SaaS businesses looking for a methodology that connects ICP (Ideal Customer Profile) definition directly to pipeline and revenue.[](https://www.polarisagency.com/marketing-insights/b2b-seo-finding-the-right-seo-agency/) [[1]](https://www.polarisagency.com/marketing-insights/b2b-seo-finding-the-right-seo-agency/)
- **The SEO Works** : Best for mid-market B2B companies, particularly in complex sectors like manufacturing, multi-location services, and recruitment.[](https://seo-giant.co.uk/the-best-b2b-seo-agencies-in-the-uk-2026-guide/) [[1]](https://seo-giant.co.uk/the-best-b2b-seo-agencies-in-the-uk-2026-guide/)
- **Hallam** : Best for strategy-led, full-service digital campaigns with a specialized track record in the manufacturing and industrial sectors.[](https://www.angelfish-marketing.com/the-9-best-b2b-seo-agencies-in-the-uk-2026) [[1]](https://www.angelfish-marketing.com/the-9-best-b2b-seo-agencies-in-the-uk-2026)[[2]](https://hallam.agency/seo/)
- **Impression Digital** : Best for data-driven SEO paired with high-impact digital PR and technical search optimisation.[](https://www.polarisagency.com/marketing-insights/b2b-seo-finding-the-right-seo-agency/) [[1]](https://www.polarisagency.com/marketing-insights/b2b-seo-finding-the-right-seo-agency/)[[2]](https://www.angelfish-marketing.com/the-9-best-b2b-seo-agencies-in-the-uk-2026)

### What to Look for in a B2B SEO Partner

- **Revenue over traffic:** Focus on agencies that track pipeline, lead flow, and CRM integration rather than vanity metrics like raw traffic.[](https://thebusinessjournal.co.uk/b2b-supplier/top-15-best-b2b-seo-agencies-in-the-uk/) [[1]](https://thebusinessjournal.co.uk/b2b-supplier/top-15-best-b2b-seo-agencies-in-the-uk/)
- **Funnel mapping:** The agency must understand long B2B buying cycles and build content for every stage of the procurement journey.[](https://www.improvemarketing.co.uk/b2b-seo) [[1]](https://www.improvemarketing.co.uk/b2b-seo)
- **Typical pricing:** Most UK B2B small-to-medium enterprises pay between £1,500 and £5,000 per month for strategic SEO work, while enterprise campaigns in London can range from £5,000 to £12,000+ monthly.[](https://6smarketers.com/seo-agencies-uk/) [[1]](https://6smarketers.com/seo-agencies-uk/)[[2]](https://whitehat-seo.co.uk/blog/seo-package-prices)

To help narrow down the best option, please share:

- Your **industry or business model** (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, professional services)
- Your **monthly budget range** 
- Your **primary goal** (e.g., demo requests, lead volume, brand authority)
